core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss Print Design with SaaS Utility.
Emotion First: Data is boring; the tool must feel 'Magical' and 'Optimistic'.
Content is King: The data charts are the heroes; UI must recede but frame them perfectly.
Negative Space: 3x more padding than standard dashboards.
Contrast: High-contrast typography (Black vs White) with Electric Violet accents.
anti_patterns: No center-aligned layouts for data-heavy sections.
No full-screen gradients (use subtle noise/grain instead).

usage_rules: Headings (H1-H3): Use 'Outfit' with 'font-bold' or 'font-extrabold'. Tracking tight (-0.02em).
Body Text: Use 'Manrope'. Excellent for data/numbers.
Data/Code: Use 'JetBrains Mono' for raw data values or CSV previews.
Hierarchy: H1 (text-4xl/5xl), H2 (text-3xl), H3 (text-xl uppercase tracking-widest).
typography.installation: Import via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Outfit:wght@400;500;700;800&display=swap');

colors.theme_strategy: Light Mode Primary (Clean, Swiss). Dark Mode Secondary (Pro/Cyber).

primary.name: Electric Violet
primary.usage: Primary CTAs, AI Magic moments, Active States.

rules: Never use pure black (#000000). Use Slate-950 or Slate-900.
Gradients are allowed ONLY for the 'Predictive Analysis' AI button or overlay.
Chart colors must be distinct and color-blind friendly.

spacing.scale: Tailwind default but shifted up. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers.
spacing.rule: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).

grids.dashboard_home: Bento Grid (Mode A). Mix of col-span-1, col-span-2, row-span-2.
grids.data_entry: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Visible borders between cells.
grids.landing_hero: Asymmetric Split. Text on left (40%), Visual on right (60%) overlapping.

containers.card_style: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm rounded-xl hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200

buttons.primary: bg-violet-600 text-white hover:bg-violet-700 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-semibold shadow-lg shadow-violet-500/20 transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 hover:text-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-50 rounded-lg px-4 py-2

inputs.style: bg-white border-slate-200 focus:border-violet-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-100 rounded-lg h-12 px-4 text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 transition-all
inputs.label: block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5

cards.dashboard: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 shadow-[0_2px_10px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] p-6 hover:border-violet-100 transition-colors

navigation.sidebar: bg-slate-900 text-white w-64 fixed h-full border-r border-slate-800
navigation.header: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-100 sticky top-0 z-50

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for 'Predictive Analysis' overlays. Class: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-lg border border-white/40 shadow-2xl.
visual_enhancers.noise_texture: Add a subtle noise texture to the Landing Page background to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: All buttons must have active scale (scale-95). All cards must lift on hover (-translate-y-1).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use colored shadows for primary actions (shadow-violet-500/25).

assets.icons: Lucide React (default). Use stroke-width={1.5} for a refined look.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is Slate-900 on White, or White on Slate-900. Avoid gray-on-gray.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-violet-500 ring-offset-2) are MANDATORY.

testing.rule: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links) MUST have a kebab-case data-testid.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS FIRST: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
2. SETUP TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js to include the 'violet' and 'slate' colors if not present, and add the 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' font families.
3. COMPONENT LIBRARY: Use Shadcn UI for complex logic (Select, Dialog, Popover) but STYLE them using the classes defined in 'components' section above.
4. LANDING PAGE: Build a custom Landing Page using the 'Asymmetric Split' layout. Use the 'hero_abstract' image.
5. DASHBOARD: Build the Dashboard using the 'Bento Grid' layout.
6. DATA ENTRY: Build the Data Entry table using the 'Grid Borders' style.
7. PREDICTIVE ANALYSIS: Use the 'Glassmorphism' style for the AI prediction results overlay.
8. FILE UPLOAD: Make the dropzone large (p-12) with a dashed border (border-dashed border-2 border-slate-300).
9. DO NOT ASK QUESTIONS. Just build it.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
